action_estimate.semantics: One current typed action, no request_id or gameplay receipt. Advisory native Shift test only; no execution or funds reservation. NoEst and ui.apply are unavailable. NoTest marks possible test/execution differences. Native auxiliary PSA allocation and monotonic generation effects are allowed; both RNG streams are restored. One estimate start per world per second; no fairness or latency guarantee.

conventions.bulk_actions: Larger areas and bulk fleet operations compose individual ordinary actions. Each action has its own outcome; partial completion is possible.

control_reference.semantics: Resolve one explicitly selected current target to an actuator reference and opaque mutation tokens only; no attributes or lists. Raw IDs deliberately select the current occupant, including after restart. Never silently refresh a prior action or infer cross-boot identity.

conventions.custom_news: news.custom is recipient-scoped current-boot custom GS news metadata. Select one news_id with display.text kind news_custom_text; encoded input is retained, visible text uses live native names/language. Cursors bind the company incarnation. References are historical. Retention loss sets gap. No hard per-render work bound.
conventions.direction_coordinates: Direction values are screen diagonals with map-coordinate offsets: 0 NE=(-1,0), 1 SE=(0,1), 2 SW=(1,0), 3 NW=(0,-1). Road-bit masks are NW=1, SW=2, SE=4, NE=8.
conventions.entity_handles: id, generation and opaque engine_instance_id are required; refresh handles after an engine restart; world epoch is required in the bridge envelope
conventions.land_info: House descriptions, per-tile cargo acceptance and company-specific clearing checks share query-local callback PSA writes. Clear preview retains native QueryCost quota, ownership, cost and town-rating test semantics. Native query scratch and presentation/debug state can change; no funds are checked or reserved.
conventions.map_pagination: map.region uses live row-major pages: repeat the same region with after_offset=next_after_offset until complete=true. Each page has its own page_tick; pages do not form an atomic snapshot.
conventions.observation_intervals: Text rendering, refit probing, land information, station coverage, linear control-reference selectors and order/page control tokens share one process-global admission interval. Valuation and station waiting have separate process-global intervals. Each admitted call may exceed the cooperative tick slice.
conventions.pagination: next_after_id is the last examined pool slot; pages may be empty before the end of a sparse pool
conventions.question_pagination: goal.questions returns paired next_after_id and next_after_generation cursors. Omitting after_generation preserves legacy whole-ID skipping. Client-private prompts belong only to the actual native client window.
conventions.removal: terrain.clear demolishes depots, airports, docks, locks, canals and other removable tiles under normal gameplay rules
conventions.road_access: Road depot and bay-stop direction selects the entrance neighbor. Its reciprocal road bit is 2,1,8,4 for directions 0,1,2,3 respectively; matching bits alone do not establish native feasibility or an entire route. For drive_through road stops, directions 0/2 select the X axis (bits10) and 1/3 select the Y axis (bits5). Typed depot/stop construction does not run GUI automatic neighbor-road connection. Compose road.pieces.build or other road commands as needed, with separate native outcomes. Construction success and positive vehicle speed do not establish arrival, loading or delivery.
conventions.station_creation: Omitting station_id selects a new station; reusing an active or gray station requires its handle. adjacent=false permits the normal adjacent-station joining search.
conventions.station_site: Selected loaded rail/road specifications and normal extent64 use native QueryCost feasibility and GUI rectangular coverage. Coverage callback PSA writes are query-local. Cargo name previews are plain UTF-8 at most64bytes with name_truncated; full labels use display.text. Admission bounds starts, not callback latency or temporary string expansion. Joined coverage and irregular airport tiles are excluded.
conventions.tiles: native tile index or x/y map coordinates
conventions.vehicle_parts: Fleet pages contain at most 256 part records and mark omitted parts with parts_truncated. Use vehicle.details and its consist_version-bound part pagination to inspect longer consists.
conventions.visual_actions: Typed actions are shared by text and visual players. Visual game-state perception is genuine PNG capture; structured world queries remain text-only. ui.apply is an optional image-bound native-input path.

human_only: client display preferences and GUI configuration
